title: Cumulative sea-level rise caused by melting glaciers

source.name: Glacier Mass Balance Intercomparison Exercise (GlaMBIE)
source.publisher: World Glacier Monitoring Service (WGMS), University of Zurich

notes: WGMS/GlaMBIE: glaciers lost 6,542 billion tonnes of ice between 2000 and 2023, contributing 18mm to global sea-level rise. Midpoint approximated as roughly linear given the reported acceleration; figures approximate as publicly reported.
